bgkaiserdom.name: Bamberg Cathedral
bgkaiserdom.slogan: Four towers, an emperor's tomb and a horseman nobody can name.
bgkaiserdom.line: Pope Clement II lies here: the only papal grave in Germany, and north of the Alps.

bgaltesrathaus.name: Old Town Hall
bgaltesrathaus.slogan: A painted town hall afloat in the middle of the Regnitz.
bgaltesrathaus.line: Built in 1386 in the middle of the Regnitz river, it is reached by two bridges and was rebuilt in 1744-1756.

bgschlenkerla.name: Schlenkerla
bgschlenkerla.slogan: Smoked beer from the cask, poured under a Gothic ceiling.
bgschlenkerla.line: The tavern dates to 1405, when it was a pub called Zum Blauen Löwen, the Blue Lion.

bgvierzehnheiligen.name: Vierzehnheiligen
bgvierzehnheiligen.slogan: A shepherd's vision became Balthasar Neumann's rococo ballroom.
bgvierzehnheiligen.line: A shepherd saw a crying child here in 1445; Neumann's basilica, built 1743-1772, marks the spot of the apparition.

bgopernhaus.name: Margravial Opera House
bgopernhaus.slogan: Wilhelmine's wooden theatre, still glowing in Bayreuth.
bgopernhaus.line: Built in the 1740s with a Bibiena-designed wooden interior, it seats about 500 and joined UNESCO World Heritage in 2012.
